tier1.text: Each thoracic vertebra is a spine bone that anchors ribs at the back of the chest. The twelve thoracic vertebrae, numbered T1 to T12, sit in the upper back. Thoracic vertebrae have facets, small flat spots where the ribs are attached. The thoracic vertebrae are part of the rib cage, which protects the heart and lungs.

sentences.text: Each thoracic vertebra is a spine bone that anchors ribs at the back of the chest.

quotes.quote: The thoracic cage (rib cage) forms the thorax (chest) portion of the body. It consists of the 12 pairs of ribs with their costal cartilages and the sternum (). The ribs are anchored posteriorly to the 12 thoracic vertebrae (T1–T12).
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: vertebra: individual bone in the neck and back regions of the vertebral column
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The twelve thoracic vertebrae, numbered T1 to T12, sit in the upper back.

quotes.quote: thoracic vertebrae: twelve vertebrae numbered as T1–T12 that are located in the thoracic region (upper back) of the vertebral column
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Thoracic vertebrae have facets, small flat spots where the ribs are attached.

quotes.quote: Thoracic vertebrae have several additional articulation sites, each of which is called a facet, where a rib is attached.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: facet: small, flattened area on a bone for an articulation (joint) with another bone, or for muscle attachment
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The thoracic vertebrae are part of the rib cage, which protects the heart and lungs.

quotes.quote: The thoracic cage, also known as the ribcage, is the skeleton of the chest, and consists of the ribs, sternum, thoracic vertebrae, and costal cartilages (). The thoracic cage encloses and protects the organs of the thoracic cavity, including the heart and lungs.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.
